attackOutcomePartition.reason: A second chip would tune the payoff of an already rewarded card-target result rather than fill a missing transition mapping.

authority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only ward-break-without-blood for one separately preregistered direct, trace-sentinel and explicit-null identity preflight. frontierScope.claimBoundary: This zero-row audit may select at most one source-defined transition for a separately preregistered identity preflight. frontierScope.included: One deterministic boolean mapping at hit_enemy after final Attack damage, enemy Ward absorption and HP loss are known. It may only turn the existing per-target pending-chip hit flag on when positive pre-hit enemy Ward becomes exactly zero without HP loss.

selectedPrimitive.exactEffect: For Duskblade only, an Attack that absorbs positive enemy Ward to exactly zero while dealing zero HP loss sets the existing per-card, per-target pending-chip hit flag true. It awards the same one implicit Facet chip already used by blood; it never adds a second chip when loss is positive.
selectedPrimitive.multiHitSafety: The existing boolean hit flag collapses multiple hits. Later blood or another hit cannot stack this primitive within the same card and target.
